people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
translations.bsb: “Come,” said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.
translations.kjv: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
translations.asv: And he said, Come. And Peter went down from the boat, and walked upon the waters to come to Jesus.
